key_insight: BW-FISTA accelerates composite optimization over Gaussian Bures–Wasserstein space to a minimax-optimal O(k⁻²) objective gap when the objective admits suitable convex affine lifts.
engineering_relevance: For Gaussian variational inference with log-concave, log-smooth targets, the method improves the convergence rate from O(k⁻¹) to O(k⁻²).
method: Lift Gaussian-measure optimization into Euclidean affine transport maps.
Apply accelerated proximal gradients to convex smooth and convex proximable lifted terms.
Handle the entropy term in Gaussian variational inference with an efficient, exact proximal step.
evidence_signal: Synthetic experiments numerically verify the predicted acceleration; the abstract reports no real-world benchmarks.
watch_item: The accelerated guarantee depends on convexity, smoothness, and proximal tractability of the affine lifts, so applicability must be checked for each objective.
paper_title: An Accelerated Proximal Gradient Method for Bures-Wasserstein Space
